subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The library is the right place __to write an article__ from a journal.
solution:
The correct answer is "**to read an article.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The original phrase in the question, "to write an article", suggests the action of creating or drafting an article.<
